$comment: Phase 18 (0.1.6) Task 0 demand-gate registry and scope gate. Machine-checkable source of truth for plans/018-Release-0-1-6-Coding-Agent-Capability-Closeouts.md: the five demand-gated coding-agent closeouts (durable ACP session store; network-free native sandbox backend; PDF/Office document reader; recursive delete + brace-expanding glob; checkpoint persistence for loaded-skill bodies + full read-path state) each with a status (demanded/deferred), named demand evidence, and an allowed-file scope. A closeout flips to demanded ONLY by committing named demand evidence here (host/integration/operator + date); a demanded closeout's implementation task may then land. A deferred closeout's allowed files are byte-immutable (enforced by scripts/phase18-freeze.test.mjs against scripts/phase18-baseline.json hashes) — implementation diff on a deferred closeout fails loud. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json and 0.1.6 changes none of it. 0.1.6 is additive-only against the post-0.1.5 surface: no --allow-break, no compat baseline regeneration beyond the version literal unless a clean plain gate proves 0 breaking deltas first. Amendment requires a recorded deviation entry below. Baseline evidence for regression comparison lives in scripts/phase18-baseline.json.
baseline: 0.1.5 (plan 017 exit gate passed 2026-08-11; signed tag v0.1.5; 49 publishable manifests; audit 0 moderate; compat baselines current at 0.1.5)

demandGates.rule: A closeout ships ONLY with a named demand record (host, integration, or operator + date) committed to this manifest; a closeout without demand evidence stays deferred and its allowed files stay byte-immutable. Demand flips status here BEFORE implementation starts; the implementation task token flips to done only when its task passes its checks. Roadmap Priority/Dependency Rule 6 and Release Validation Checklist rule 'no blocker converted into a skip' both apply: deferred closeouts are recorded in the changelog and this manifest, never silently skipped.

closeouts.title: Durable ACP session store behind a host-owned seam

demandEvidence.integration: Clay requires ACP sessions (live registry state: session bindings, mode/config values) to survive agent restart; the in-memory registry (cap 32 default / 128 hard) is insufficient for the resume workflow.

closeouts.rationale: plan 010/012 further actions: live task registry in-memory (cap 512, FIFO); modes/config report table defaults. 0.1.1 (plan 013 Task 5) shipped the ownership-scoping guidance this enforces.

closeouts.title: Network-free native sandbox backend (SandboxAdapter)

demandEvidence.integration: operator instruction to complete plan 018 Task 3 with the native-sandbox gate demanded; hosts without a container runtime need a network-free native containment backend (egress denial + rlimits + cwd containment, fail closed where netns is unavailable)

closeouts.rationale: plan 012 further action: Docker is the only reference SandboxAdapter backend; hosts without a container runtime need a native, network-free backend that fails closed on platforms that cannot deny egress by construction.

closeouts.title: PDF/Office document reader as a bounded host-selected parser adapter

demandEvidence.integration: operator instruction to complete plan 018 Task 4 with the doc-reader gate demanded; coding agents need bounded literal-text extraction for PDF/Office documents without executing embedded content or fetching external resources (roadmap coding-gaps closeout)

closeouts.rationale: plans 004/roadmap non-goals: no PDF/Office reader today; demand-gated. New optional package if it ships (manifest count 49 -> 50, the only allowed count change).

closeouts.title: Recursive delete and brace-expanding glob (opt-in flags)

demandEvidence.integration: operator instruction to complete plan 018 Task 5 with the delete-glob gate demanded; coding agents need a single-call recursive delete and brace-expanding glob as explicit opt-in flags (plan 004 further actions: only if pattern/usage demand justifies it; roadmap 0.1.6 demand-gated line).

closeouts.rationale: plan 004 further actions: recursive delete and brace-expanding glob only if pattern/usage demand justifies it; hand-rolled * ? ** matcher stays the default either way.

closeouts.title: Checkpoint persistence for loaded-skill bodies + full read-path state (opt-in)

demandEvidence.integration: operator instruction to complete plan 018 Task 6 with the checkpoint-bodies gate demanded; 0.1.3 names-only persistence is insufficient for the resume flow: the restored body is whatever the live registry serves at resume (changed skill silently swaps instructions, removed skill renders nothing, offline registry cannot re-render), so bodies mode persists the exact loaded instructions and re-renders them registry-independently.

closeouts.rationale: plans 003/004 further actions: 0.1.3 (plan 015 Task 4) shipped opt-in names-only persistence; bodies mode ships only if a named host's resume flow proves names-only insufficient.

tasks.$comment: per-task evidence tokens; 'done' when the task passes its checks, 'pending' until then. Task 0 sets itself done at freeze. Task 1 (primitive review + threat model) lands when >=1 closeout is demanded. Tasks 2-6 land ONLY after their closeout's status flips to demanded with named evidence. Task 7 (docs, changelog, bump, exit gate) lands last. The phase18-freeze.test.mjs state machine asserts: while a closeout's task is pending, its allowed files are byte-identical to the Task 0 baseline hashes (absent files stay absent); once a task is done, the closeout MUST be demanded; a done task with a deferred closeout fails loud.
